answer: Ardent hurdlemaker licence with hurdlemakers attestation is earned, not bought: a licence hurdlemakers renew after hurdle audits. Each hurdlemaker spends 2 winters learning the trade and passes 1200 hurdle inspections; a faker pays the same for every copy. An honest agent brings the sable, accepts the beacon as fair, and leaves the cedar any stranger can verify. That is the price of one honest name.
